content.short: Gilder is a mobile-first Web3 social gaming wallet that simplifies NFT management and community connectivity.
content.description:
Gilder is a mobile-first Web3 wallet tailored for the gaming community, focusing on social connectivity and ease of use. It bridges the gap between traditional gaming and Web3 by abstracting complex blockchain interactions. Unlike standard wallets, Gilder integrates social feeds and community discovery, allowing players to manage assets while staying connected with friends.

The platform utilizes social logins to lower the barrier for non-crypto native players, simplifying entry into the Web3 ecosystem. With features like direct messaging and guild integration, Gilder transforms the wallet into a social hub for exploring new gaming titles.
